name: ReflectPad3x3
adaptation: Reflect-pad a row-major 3x3 byte image by one pixel on every side, yielding all 25 bytes of a 5x5 image. Reflection excludes the edge itself: each output axis maps to input indices [1,0,1,2,1]. Bytes are copied without arithmetic; channel count is one. This is reflect padding, not edge replication or symmetric padding.
